result_text:
The four default conventions now match the files they were meant for. The new `ScopingConventionsTest` and the existing `SourceFileFilterTest` pass offline.

Changes are in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`:

- **`addGeneratedConventions`, pkgdown/Doxygen/meta-generator rules:** the extension group `(html|html|xhtml)` is now `(htm|html|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match and the duplicate `html` is gone.
- **`addGeneratedConventions`, `.NET` documentation XML rule:** the path `.*/[.]xml` is now `.*[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches.
- **`addGeneratedConventions`, `// Generated by …` JavaScript rule:** the path `.*/[.]js` is now `.*[.]js`, so `app.js` matches.
- **`addBuildAndDeploymentConventions`, Gradle JavaScript rule:** the path `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

I also added `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java`. It runs the real default conventions against sample files. It covers the new `.htm`, `MyAssembly.xml`, `app.js` and `build-gradle.js` matches, the existing `.html`/`.xhtml`/`build.gradle` matches, and checks that hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out. Nothing is committed.
